Mara whispers, “I changed my mind.”

parsed.thought_provoking_evidence_quote: If Mara stopped her hand, did she still commit an act? If the machine says “intention,” who gave it that word—the brain, the lawyer, the program, or the judge?
parsed.core_provocation_clarity_evidence_quote: The judge must decide when a thought becomes an intention—and when an intention becomes an action.
